title: $\mathcal{C}^\infty$ Smooth Trajectory Planning with Application to Soft Robots
description:
arXiv:2611.05615v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: High motion performance and avoiding structural vibrations rely on smooth trajectory planning. The smoothness requirement depends on the robot's complexity in terms of the number of degrees of freedom and system order due to the flexibility of the joints and links.
